captions.method: Whisper-small context transcript reconciled with short silence-bounded recognition; brand spelling normalized; no certified individual-word alignment

captions.method: Whisper-small context transcript reconciled with short silence-bounded recognition; brand spelling normalized; no certified individual-word alignment

captions.method: Whisper-small context transcript reconciled with short silence-bounded recognition; brand spelling normalized; no certified individual-word alignment

captions.method: Whisper-small context transcript reconciled with short silence-bounded recognition; brand spelling normalized; no certified individual-word alignment

captions.method: Whisper-small context transcript reconciled with short silence-bounded recognition; brand spelling normalized; no certified individual-word alignment
